content.text:
Build now succeeds (only a benign chunk-size warning remains). 

Fix: `docs/package.json` was missing `@pantoken/plugin-custom-theme-colors` as a workspace devDependency, so pnpm never symlinked it into `docs/node_modules`. Since the rendered scaffold app in `.vitepress/cache/canvas-rce-src` has no `node_modules` of its own, Vite's build resolution walked up to `docs/` and failed to find the package. Added the dependency and ran `vp install`.
